load_word_embeddings_from_glove: load pre-trained GloVe word embeddings into a PyTorch nn.Embedding layer from a text file
init_word_embeddings_with_strategy: initialize word embedding weights using strategies like orthogonal, sparse, normal, uniform, kaiming, or xavier
load_vecs_case_insensitive_matching: load word vectors with case-insensitive matching that tries original, capitalized, and lowercase forms
init_embeddings_to_zero: initialize an nn.Embedding layer with zero weights and a specified padding index
review_load_vecs_function: review the load_vecs function that maps words to embeddings with fallback case normalization
